preset.description: Workspace preset: npx create-nx-workspace --preset=@rivetjs/nx (init + a first Rivet app).

init.description: Add @rivetjs/nx to a workspace: Rivet tooling dependencies, the inference plugin in nx.json.

application.description: Create a Rivet app from a create-rivet starter (static, server, ui, minimal).

library.description: Create a Rivet component library (tree-shakeable subpath exports, Vitest, optional package build).

component.description: Add a resumable component (+ test, optional story route).

route.description: Add a file route: dynamic segments, load(…) / actions(…) / guard(…) exports, folder layout.

layout.description: Add a _layout.tsx to a routes folder (optional guard(…) export).

api-route.description: Add an endpoint route (onGet(…) / onPost(…) / … request handler exports).

ui-setup.description: Add @rivetjs/ui + Tailwind v4 + its styles to an app.

i18n-setup.description: Add compile-time i18n (@rivetjs/i18n): config, catalogs, Vite plugin.
